note: Owner hand-picks that regeneration must not destroy. build_watchlist regenerates data/card_watchlist.json from the live eFV board and flags the top 12 prospects hot, so a rebuild off a moved board would silently demote picks the owner made by hand. Every card_id listed under hot is forced hot=true whenever the generator emits that card; cards not listed keep the generated flag; an id the generator no longer emits is ignored, because watchlist membership is a watchlist edit, not an override. Captured 2026-08-16 from the committed data/card_watchlist.json (22 hot cards).
